title: cs-codex-turn reads Codex's model migration dialog as ready and pastes the prompt into it
foundBy: session agent, re-recording the agent fixtures for a bump to Codex 0.157.1

evidence.verified: `go test ./internal/cli/ -run 'TestCodexTurnAnswersADialogOrSaysWhoMust|TestTurnDriversSayWhetherAnAgentIsInATurn' -count=1` passes on 72aeff9, and both dialog cases fail without its driver change. In a sandbox on the rebuilt image, Codex 0.157.1 was offered gpt-6-sol from a replayed catalog. The driver logged `answered a dialog: Use existing model`, and Codex wrote the acknowledgement to config.toml. The matrix's codex-login-shared replay passed with the same offer, and `make ci` passed with all 14 agent replays.

resolution: The Codex driver keeps a table of known one-time dialogs, as the Claude driver does. It declines a newer-model offer with 2, which keeps the configured model, and says so in the turn log. Any other modal, a migration that cannot be declined among them, fails the turn at once and quotes the screen, and the driver presses nothing on it. The live catalog no longer offers gpt-5.6-sol an upgrade, so the recorded fixtures do not show the dialog.
details:
Codex 0.157.0 added a dialog that offers a newer model when the configured one has a successor. With `model = "gpt-5.6-sol"`, which the agent matrix configures, it opens at startup as `Meet GPT-6 Sol` with `1. Try new model` and `2. Use existing model`.

The dialog's footer, `enter/esc confirm · ctrl+c quit`, contains the ` · ` separator that `detect_state` takes for Codex's status line. The driver therefore reads the dialog as ready and pastes the prompt into it. No turn starts, and the driver exits 3 with `could not locate the codex rollout JSONL after submitting` about 25 seconds later.

Choosing `2. Use existing model` writes `"gpt-5.6-sol" = "gpt-6-sol"` under `[notice.model_migrations]` in config.toml, and the dialog does not return. The image's Codex is held at 0.155.1 by the lent-login failure in SBX-084, and that release has no such dialog. A bump to 0.157 needs the driver to recognise the dialog and keep the configured model.
